searchText: How did you do that? Is it easily configurable in kurtosis? Yes, very easy. Add `seconds_per_slot: 4` under the `network_params` section. Will be very useful for kurtosis tests with fulu only activated at the third epoch. <@412614104222531604> , sometimes I have some issues with goomy blobs, no blobs are spammed at all after a given slot. (cf attached logs.) Context: I start 3 nodes, and I quickly stop the third one. (To eventually test sync with the stopped node.) My kurtosis config: ```yaml participants_matrix: el: - el_type: geth el_image: geth-custom:latest cl: - cl_type: prysm cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest cl_max_mem: 4096 count: 2 cl_extra_params: - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1 - --subscribe-all-subnets - --log-format=json vc_extra_params: - --log-format=json - cl_type: prysm cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest cl_max_mem: 4096 cl_extra_params: - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1 - --log-format=json vc_extra_params: - --log-format=json network_params: electra_fork_epoch: 1 # eip7594_fork_epoch: 1 snooper_enabled: true global_log_level: debug additional_services: - dora - goomy_blob - prometheus_grafana dora_params: image: ethpandaops/dora:fulu-support ethereum_metrics_exporter_enabled: true ``` (Currently in Prysm, peerDAS is activated at electra) Additionnal info: The blobs txs seem to stop when I stop the node, and to resume when I restart the node. cf logs. ==> Maybe it could be possible the blob spammer is kinda dependant of my third node? cc <@808969530608451584> Also, running `docker restart goomy-blob-spammer--6603a4cfc6104ca8940140ec815e5ac3` seems to solve the issue. yea, goomy can be getting stuck sometimes 😅 restarting it will help in that situation 🙂 but I'm also working on a fix (replacing it with an enhanced version of the tool)

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content: How did you do that? Is it easily configurable in kurtosis?

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: Yes, very easy. Add `seconds_per_slot: 4` under the `network_params` section.

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content: Will be very useful for kurtosis tests with fulu only activated at the third epoch.

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content:
<@412614104222531604> , sometimes I have some issues with goomy blobs, no blobs are spammed at all after a given slot. (cf attached logs.)

Context: I start 3 nodes, and I quickly stop the third one. (To eventually test sync with the stopped node.)

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content:
My kurtosis config:
```yaml
participants_matrix:
  el:
    - el_type: geth
      el_image: geth-custom:latest
  cl:
      - cl_type: prysm
        cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest
        vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest
        cl_max_mem: 4096
        count: 2
        cl_extra_params:
          - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1
          - --subscribe-all-subnets
          - --log-format=json
        vc_extra_params:
          - --log-format=json
      - cl_type: prysm
        cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest
        vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest
        cl_max_mem: 4096
        cl_extra_params:
          - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1
          - --log-format=json
        vc_extra_params:
          - --log-format=json
network_params:
  electra_fork_epoch: 1
  # eip7594_fork_epoch: 1
snooper_enabled: true
global_log_level: debug
additional_services:
  - dora
  - goomy_blob
  - prometheus_grafana
dora_params:
  image: ethpandaops/dora:fulu-support
ethereum_metrics_exporter_enabled: true
```

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content: (Currently in Prysm, peerDAS is activated at electra)

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content:
Additionnal info:
The blobs txs seem to stop when I stop the node, and to resume when I restart the node.
cf logs.

==> Maybe it could be possible the blob spammer is kinda dependant of my third node?

excerpts.content: Also, running `docker restart goomy-blob-spammer--6603a4cfc6104ca8940140ec815e5ac3` seems to solve the issue.
